content.title: Sarepta Gets Breathing Room in $700 Million Debt Restructure
content.summary: Prior to the deal, Sarepta had been staring down $1.2 billion of debt and warned in filings earlier this year that its cash flow may not be enough to pay that obligation, which was due in 2027.  As part of the transaction, the drugmaker pushed back some of its debt maturities by three years.  Sarepta is swapping its debt for a smaller amount and giving investors cash and shares, which could dilute the stock.
